player_prompt.intro:
Yin ee Player {player_id} ee game de HighSociety (version 2-player).
Kelo flow:  Kaad prestige 10 ee auctioned tök ee tök.
Kelo bidding:    Auction kelo, ee chɔ̈ɔ̈c money card 1-11 ee reveal.
            • Bid yök ee win prestige card ee discard money card kelo.
            • Bid pöör ee keep money card kelo.
            • Tie -> bid kɔ̈ɔ̈ ee return ee prestige card kelo ee re-auctioned.
Kelo scoring:    Tök ee auction 10, ee add **cash pöör + prestige points**.
            *Net-worth* yök ee win (tie pöör ee draw).

**Kelo syntax**  →  bid kaad ee '[7]' ee '[11]'.

board.money_cards: Kä ye ke wëu tɔ̈ɔ̈c në kaardu yic: {money}

invalid_move.wrong_format: A dhil naŋ kaar tök ë wëu [X].
invalid_move.card_not_held: Yïn acïï wëu ye ke kaardu yök.

message.auction_result: P0 acɛ̈ɛ̈l {bid0}, P1 acɛ̈ɛ̈l {bid1}. Raan {winner} aɣɔ̈ɔ̈̈n akwɛ̈ɛ̈rɛ̈ {prize} (dɛ̈t {total}).

outcome.draw: Käk kedhiɛ ke käke wëu {nw0}  kë thöŋ.
